mainEntity.name: What primary factors drive the cost of building a bonus room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Total costs vary significantly based on square footage, foundation requirements, roof tie-in complexity, and interior finish choices. A basic ground-floor expansion with standard drywall and simple lighting costs less than an addition requiring plumbing for an attached bathroom or wet bar. Additional factors include electrical load upgrades, exterior integration like matching existing stucco, and HVAC tie-ins or supplemental mini-split systems. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms offers clear project estimating, negotiable pricing discussions, and a veteran discount to help homeowners determine an accurate project scope aligned with their investment goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost drivers include total square footage, foundation work, plumbing additions, electrical demands, drywall finishes, exterior stucco matching, and HVAC equipment needs.
